weapon.name: Fists
weapon.special: Strike [2 - SP]: Deal 2d6+Anger Bludgeoning Damage.

weapon.name: Stun Blaster
weapon.special: Zap Shot [2 - SP]: Roll a d6, if the result is higher than the target HP, apply the unconscious condition. On a failure deal 1d6 Stun Damage.

weapon.name: Junker
weapon.special: Shrapnel Shot [3 - SP]: Deal 1d6 Slashing Damage and apply the bleeding condition.

weapon.name: Flintlock
weapon.special: Powder Shot [2 - SP]: Deal 3d6 Slashing Damage, but the weapon malfunctions.

weapon.name: .33 Blaster
weapon.special: Spray [2 - SP]: Deal 2d6+3 Laser Damage.

weapon.name: .66 Blaster
weapon.special: Aim Shot [3 - SP]: Gain 1 Prowess on the attack, deal 2d6+3 Laser Damage.

weapon.name: .33 Crankshot
weapon.basic: Crank [3 - SP]: Deal 1d6 Laser Damage, and roll a d6. If the result is 3+ deal an additional 1d6 Laser damage. This action repeats until the roll fails.

weapon.name: .33 Gauss Revolver
weapon.special: Spray Shot [2 - SP]: Roll a d6, on a 4+ deal 8 Laser Damage. On a failure deal 1d6+3 Laser Damage.
weapon.crit: Laser bounces to a hostile target within 15 ft of the original target dealing 1d6+3 Laser Damage ignoring AC.

weapon.name: .66 Gauss Revolver
weapon.special: Bounce Shot [3 - SP]: Deal 2d6+3 Laser Damage. Roll a d6, on a 4+, the Laser bounces to a hostile target within 15 ft of the original target and makes an additional attack.

weapon.name: Coil Revolver
weapon.special: Charge Shot [3 - SP]: Roll 3d6, for each dice if the result is 4+ deal 6 Burn damage, otherwise deal only 1.

weapon.name: .66 Repeater
weapon.special: Rapid Fire [3 - SP]: Deal 3d6 Laser Damage, if the damage result is 10+, roll an additional 3d6.

weapon.name: .66 Sharpshooter
weapon.special: Aim Shot [4 - SP]: Gain 1 Prowess on the attack, deal 3d6+3 Laser Damage.

weapon.name: .99 Sharpshooter
weapon.special: Piercing Shot [5 - SP]: Ignore cover bonuses and deal 5d6 Laser Damage.

weapon.name: Coil Rifle
weapon.basic: Charge [2 - SP]: Hold the attack, and increase the damage by 1d6.
weapon.special: Shot [4 - SP]: Fire the weapon and unleash the held damage. If no damage is held, deal 1d6 Burn Damage.

weapon.name: .33 Splitter
weapon.special: Suppress [3 - SP]: Deal 2d6 Laser Damage and push the target back 10 ft.

weapon.name: .66 Splitter
weapon.special: Heavy Shot [4 - SP]: Deal 5d6 Laser Damage.

weapon.name: Annhilaser
weapon.basic: Rev [5 - SP]: Charge the weapon and gain 8 charges.
weapon.special: Shot [1 - SP]: Expend any number of charges against a single target. Each charge deals 1d6 Laser damage.

weapon.name: Plasma Spewer
weapon.special: Fireball [2 - SP]: Deal 2d6+3 Burn Damage to a target within 30 ft from you.

weapon.name: HV-PB
weapon.basic: Basic [5 - SP]: All targets in a 15 ft radius of the blast must make an Agility Check of 4+ or take 6d6 Laser damage.
weapon.crit: Crit: Deal 2d6 Burn Damage to all damaged targets within 15 ft of the blast.

weapon.name: Compound Bow
weapon.special: Aim Shot [3 - SP]: Gain 2 Prowess on the attack, and deal 4d6 Slashing Damage.

weapon.name: Energy Bow
weapon.basic: Charge [2 - SP]: Hold the attack, and increase the damage by 1d6.
weapon.special: Release [4 - SP]: Fire the weapon and unleash the held damage. If no damage is held, deal 1d6 Laser Damage.

weapon.name: Saw Launcher
weapon.special: Bounce Shot [4 - SP]: Deal 3d6+3 Slashing Damage and the saw bounces to a hostile target within 15 ft of the original target and makes an additional attack.

weapon.name: Neuro-Bolt
weapon.basic: Target [1 - SP]: Lock onto a target. This resets at the end of your turn. You may lock onto the same target multiple times.
weapon.special: Fire [1 - SP]: Deal 1d6 Laser Damage for each locked target.
weapon.crit: Double damage result for each locked target.

weapon.name: Dagger
weapon.basic: Slash [1 - SP]: Deal 1d6+Agility Slashing Damage. On a 7+ damage result, deal an additional 6 Slashing Damage.

weapon.name: Steel Knuckles
weapon.crit: Apply the Brittle Condition until the end of your next turn.

weapon.name: Barbed Bat
weapon.basic: Strike [1 - SP]: Deal 2d6+Anger Slashing or Bludgeoning Damage.
weapon.crit: Apply the Crippled Condition until the end of your next turn or the Bleeding Condition.

weapon.name: Crowbar
weapon.crit: Apply the Crippled Condition until the end of your next turn.

weapon.name: Claw Gauntlet
weapon.special: Targeted Strike [3 - SP]: Roll a d6, on a 4+ deal 18 Slashing Damage. On a failure, deal no damage.
weapon.crit: Apply the Bleeding Condition to the target.

weapon.name: Pole
weapon.special: Sweep [3 - SP]: Roll a d6, all enemies within 10ft of you must make an Agility save higher than the dice result or take 2d6+Agility Bludgeoning Damage.

weapon.name: Spear
weapon.special: Impale [2 - SP]: Roll a contesting Anger check against a creature within 10ft, if successful deal 2d6+Anger Slashing Damage.
weapon.crit: Target is Impaled and grappled by you.

weapon.name: Plasma Glaive
weapon.special: Piercing Strike [3 - SP]: Ignore resistances and deal 2d6+Agility Laser Damage.
